  "summary": "Updates the Guix time-machine commit and bumps associated toolchain dependencies in the deterministic build manifests and CI. It updates CMake to 4.3.3, binutils to 2.47, and lief to 1.0.0 while reverting custom osslsigncode definitions back to upstream Guix packages. It also configures CMake link-warning-as-error options, disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc, and skips psutil test suites during lief packaging.",

result.summary: Updates the Guix time-machine commit and bumps associated toolchain dependencies in the deterministic build manifests and CI. It updates CMake to 4.3.3, binutils to 2.47, and lief to 1.0.0 while reverting custom osslsigncode definitions back to upstream Guix packages. It also configures CMake link-warning-as-error options, disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc, and skips psutil test suites during lief packaging.
result.problem: The Guix build environment lags behind upstream Guix package updates, missing newer compiler and toolchain versions like GCC 16 and Clang 22/23. Furthermore, building on RISC-V systems fails due to failing psutil test suites and older Guix package revisions.
evidence: Commit 7ec683756a states: 'This is necessary to unblock building on RISC-V systems. Fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36232.'
contrib/guix/manifest_gui.scm notes: 'python-lief transitively pulls in python-psutil, which has tests that fail when builing natively for riscv64. See <https://codeberg.org/guix/guix/issues/10128>.'
result.scope_notes: Modifies Guix Scheme manifests, build helper shell scripts, and CI lint dependency requirements.
result.card: Updates the Guix time-machine commit to a newer upstream revision, bumping binutils to 2.47, CMake to 4.3.3, and lief to 1.0.0. The update keeps deterministic release build environments up to date and unblocks building natively on RISC-V systems (fixing issue #36232). Additionally, it cleans up custom local package definitions such as osslsigncode in favor of upstream Guix packages and adopts CMake-native linker warning flags.
